title: Karbala waale hame
body:
Karbala waale hamei'n darse wafa dete hai
Teer par teer chale phir bhi dua dete hai
Haaye naana teri ummat me zara rehm nahi'n
Ghar se mehmaan bulaakar wo dagha dete hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab na maangenge kabhi paani chacha lout aao
sookhe hulqoom se maasoom sada dete hai
qaid wo qaid ke sone bhi na paaye Aabid
jab bhi sote hai to zanjeer hila dete hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum ne qurbaan kiye phool se masoomo'n ko
apne phoole phale gulshan ko luta dete hai
